dataset.title: Pharmaceutical exports (HS 30), 2024

indicator.name: Pharmaceutical exports
indicator.description: Value of pharmaceutical products (HS chapter 30) exported in 2024, US dollars.

source.name: International Trade Centre (ITC) Trade Map, via Wikipedia 'List of countries by pharmaceutical exports'
source.license: Wikipedia text CC BY-SA 4.0; ITC Trade Map data, attribution required
source.citation: ITC Trade Map, HS 30, 2024 (thousands of USD in the source, stored here ×1000 as USD). Table uploaded to this repo as data/raw/uploads/global_pharmaceutical_trade_2024.json.

notes: Secondary source: the table was transcribed from Wikipedia, which cites ITC; check against ITC Trade Map before relying on single values.
caveats: Totals only: no partner breakdown, so this cannot say who a country depends on.

scoring.rationale: Absolute value scales with economy size; the net-import share is the scored measure.
